newsitem.title: USA: Energy - efficient US homes to get bigger mortgages.
newsitem.headline: Energy - efficient US homes to get bigger mortgages.

text.p: Three mortgage lenders have agreed to offer bigger mortgages to people who buy energy-efficient new homes or remodel their homes to save energy, the Edison Electric Institute said Monday.
General Motors Corp's GMAC Mortgage, Norwest Corp and PHH Corp agreed to provide 15-20 percent larger mortgages to owners of homes that have EEI's "E-Seal" of approval for energy and water savings.

A dozen electric utilities serving North Carolina, Virginia, suburban Atlanta, Philadelphia, Dallas, Tampa, St. Louis and parts of Pennsylvania, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Texas and Missouri qualify for the homebuilding program.
Certifications are pending for 11 other utilities around the country.
EEI said PHH would start providing the bigger mortgages right away, while the other lenders would offer them in a few months.
